title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection, Straight Bar | Polished Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom organization with this 30-Inch wall mount towel bar from the Carolina Collection in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. Crafted from solid brass and styled as a straight bar, it keeps bath towels handy while the wall-mounted design helps save space.

Highlights:
- Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Includes mounting plates and all installation hardware
- Coordinates with Carolina Collection pieces for matching transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Multiple designer finish options available

Specs:
- Category: Towel Bars
- Collection: Carolina Collection
- Style: Traditional
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Diameter: 0.75 in
- Dimensions: 30 in L x 2 in W x 3.5 in H
- Projection: 2 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
